correctness.rationale: Theorem B (five Delta=1 instances) was fully re-verified: ran inputs/artifacts/recheck.py which passed ALL 5 ENTRIES VERIFIED (patterns 25,107,61,90,39; lb_nodes 2248,7690,7420,828,97). Independently recomputed with Fractions: dual b^T y equals claimed LP (E1 299/30, E2 9, E3 8, E4 6, E5 4), max A^T y = 1 entrywise over completely re-enumerated knapsack patterns, primal sum equals LP with coverage >= b exactly, enumeration order equals stored order, packing multisets match demands and all bin loads <=24, ceil/Delta arithmetic correct. OPT lower bounds re-confirmed by independent DFS re-search for K=OPT-1 infeasible. Theorem A k<=2: independently proved exactly with Fractions dual vertex enumeration + DFS feasibility for all 3520 instances (C(11,2)*64=3520, S-filter excludes 0) — 0 gaps, confirming IRUP. Theorem A k=3: independently reproduced screening over 84465 instances (C(11,3)*512=84480 minus 15 with S>240) with numpy dual simplex + FFD, obtaining exactly 3925 FFD-candidates matching draft; exact Fractions simplex on 100/100 random candidates showed float ceil == exact ceil and K=ceil feasible, so sampled Delta=0 holds. Theorem C: regenerated Hamming-1 neighborhoods per definition (demand +-1, size +-1 distinct, N<=30 S<=240) obtaining exactly 7+16+16+15+9=63 neighbors matching claim; exact Fractions simplex + DFS feasibility at exact ceil proved all 63 Delta=0. Boundary conditions N<=30 S<=240 verified by counting; size-1/>C/2 exclusions are explicitly scope choices not proved reductions (honestly flagged in DRAFT Sec 6). No overclaim: maximality over full ~1e8 box explicitly NOT claimed; no-Delta>=2 is labeled Observation/conjecture. Proof (exact rational certificates, exhaustive k<=2, neighbor closure) is distinguished from experimental evidence (random/local search).

originality.rationale: Checked claim is Theorems A+B+C for fixed C=24 box (k<=6 sizes 2..12 demands 1..8 N<=30 S<=240, complete knapsack pattern enumeration, exact rational Gilmore-Gomory primal-dual certificates): A: all 3520 k<=2 and 84465 k=3 instances Delta=0; B: five explicit instances E1 (5,8,9,12)x(5,8,7,7) LP 299/30 OPT11, E2 (2,7,8,10,11,12)x(6,3,5,4,5,4) LP9 OPT10, E3 LP8 OPT9, E4 LP6 OPT7, E5 LP4 OPT5 each Delta=1; C: all 63 Hamming-1 neighbors Delta=0. Kartak et al quantifies over n (total unit items) with bi=1 and unbounded L, proving n<=9 IRUP; candidate has N up to 27 (>9) with bounded C=24 and typed multiplicities, so A is not implied and E1-E5 (N=27,23,19,13) lie outside n<=9 scope; Kartak Table 1 L=18 n=12 example differs in capacity/sizes/demands and gap measure (proper gap vs standard Delta). Scheithauer-Terno and Nitsche et al give definitions/sufficient MIRUP conditions with no fixed-C table. Rietz-Dempe and Eisenbrand et al address asymptotic/worst-case growth, opposite scope to small-C exact catalog with per-instance y/lambda Fractions certificates and DFS OPT-1 infeasibility. Crossref capacity-24 query top hits are bin-packing games/discrepancy, none a C=24 catalog; arXiv abs cutting-stock (35 hits) and bin-packing+gap (2 hits) show no capacity-stratified benchmark. Exact constants (C=24, LP fractions, OPT integers, 25/107/61/90/39 patterns, 63 neighbors) and scope (complete pattern DP + duality + branch-and-bound) appear in no retrieved source. Hence no source substantively covers or implies the candidate.

value.rationale: Independently worth finding later as a citable hard-instance benchmark for bin-packing/cutting-stock solvers (arc-flow, branch-and-price, column generation need small-C hard cases), not a textbook restatement: requires full Gilmore-Gomory LP over completely enumerated patterns plus branch-and-bound optimality, beyond FFD/textbook bounds; k<=6, N<=30 non-trivial multi-pattern instances with size-1 and trivial >C/2 excluded. Not mere parameter substitution: first certified capacity-stratum census method + machine-checkable artifacts for C=24 where no table existed, with exact rational dual/primal pairs rerunnable in seconds via stdlib only. Not tiny unmotivated gain: five Delta=1 proper non-IRUP instances selected top-by-OPT-size with k-diversity, plus proved k<=3 IRUP sub-census (87985 instances) and verified strict local maximality (63/63 neighbors Delta=0); honest benchmark labeling (not claimed minimal/unique/classification) with limitations and reproducibility documented. Fallback catalog explicitly allowed by topic as independently valuable even without full maximality closure.

Neighbor definition (size moves re-sorted) regenerated to 63 matching claim; alternative orderings without re-sorting could differ by permutation but denote same multisets, no material risk.
